**Tier:** tiny, normal or risky, and why.
**Builder:** Claude Code on Opus 5.5, Cursor chat on Grok 4.7, or cloud agent.
Closes #

## Walkthrough
What changed, why, and how to try it on the preview, written for someone
new to the codebase.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Criterion: screenshot or test name

## Review
The reviewer's first line, `Reviewer agent at <sha>: no blockers`, then its
findings, each fixed (with the test that shows it) or rejected (with the
evidence). Risky PRs: the Grok 4.7 review from the Cursor chat too, starting
`Second review (Grok 4.7) at <sha>:`. Keep each review's findings under the
commit it saw.

## Docs and decisions touched
The docs/ or docs/adr/ files this changes, or "none".

## My read (Jasper)
Three to five sentences in my own words, written when I choose. It doesn't
hold up the merge. Tiny PRs skip this.
